title: Chpek Hub
features:
🎯 Aimbot
FOV Circle with customizable radius
Smooth aim (0-1 slider)
Visibility check (raycast, no wallshots)
Team check, Auto Shoot
Target any body part (Head, Torso, Arms, Legs, Random)
👁️ ESP (Wallhack)
2D Boxes (green for team, red for enemies)
Tracers (lines to targets)
Player names, distance (meters), HP text
Health bar (green → yellow → red)
🚗 Vehicle System
Vehicle Fly — fly any car, control with WASD + camera pitch
Boost — straight forward boost (fixed, no sideways drift), smooth decay, visual effects + sound
Flip — flip overturned vehicles
Works with ANY vehicle (cars, tanks, boats, planes)

Noclip (walk through walls)
Player Fly (any direction)
Infinite Jump
Custom WalkSpeed & JumpPower
